## Walkthrough

The pull request introduces a new `varU32()` method to the `Decoder` class that decodes variable-length u64 values with u32 range validation, setting an error flag on overflow. This method replaces repeated manual overflow-checking patterns across multiple dispatch and decoding functions. The changes propagate this new method throughout the codebase, updating parameter decoding in various dispatch handlers and utility files to use 32-bit decoding instead of 64-bit decoding with subsequent conversion. Tests are added to verify the new varU32 functionality with normal values, overflow conditions, and missing data scenarios.

</details>
